name: Stadium-Chinatown Station

references.note: Official main stair photo: enclosed concrete hall, red rails, yellow nosings, adjacent escalator and wood ceiling.
One public island and a fenced spare side platform/third track, without public graph links.
Beatty upper, Keefer concourse and Expo Boulevard lower entrances.
Daylight island, white steel trusses and pale curved canopies.
Existing Platform Configuration credited to TransLink, separate from the portfolio's proposed expansion drawings.
Mapped Beatty stair horizontal endpoints; about 13 m run.
Mapped concourse-to-platform stair endpoints; about 8 m run.
Mapped restricted platform polygon determines west side and longitudinal centre near Z=96 m.
Northeast tunnel ends at mapped Z24.9; transition and viaduct continue into the station. Section dimensions are inferred.
Southwest tunnel ends at mapped Z25.1; retained rail centres preserve the actual train alignment.
Mapped main lift is at source X3.989/Z20.600, beside the entrance bank. The earlier unmeasured X7.1 put its lower bypass too close to a running track.
Tim Adams, 2013, CC BY 3.0; viewed original photograph. Concrete rail decks, service walks and parapets continue beyond the station in the open air.

authoredInterior.accuracy: Reference-backed passenger topology and visible architecture; dimensions and placement are not a survey.

northwestGuidewayInference.sectionStatus: Longitudinal boundaries follow mapped railway tags; concrete thickness, maintenance walk and lining dimensions are representative, not surveyed.
northwestGuidewayInference.lateralStatus: Maintained train/rail centres are preserved. Approximate OSM tunnel-mouth centres differ by 0.69m westbound / 0.84m eastbound; rendered rails must not drift away from the train.

keefer-place.heightBasis: External stairhead and bottom use project terrain. The mapped concrete approach meets the inferred raised concourse; its residual grade is representative, not surveyed.

authoredInterior.publicPlatformTopology: one public island; restricted west side platform has no public walking edges

verticalInference.status: Photo/terrain-corroborated representative scale; not surveyed station floor elevations
verticalInference.groundDemSource: Project public/data/terrain.json via tests/helpers/city-elevation.mjs; samples describe terrain, not bridge or station slab heights
verticalInference.keeferAttachment: Raised concourse/bridge entrance. Its public floor cannot be rebound directly to the lower ground DEM; follow the official elevator/ramp approach.

unverifiedDetails: Vertical scale is inferred from an approximately 27-tread official main-stair photograph and corroborating city DEM drop near 4.49 m; these are not surveyed interior elevations.
Island length retains the original 74 m train-facing profile and is centred on the mapped spare-platform extent; the exact public platform outline is not mapped.
Lift cabin and surrounding clearances remain representative; mapped elevator point does not specify its complete footprint.

The mapped lift replaces the X7.1 guess. Adjacent escalator spacing, 2.6m lower stair width, 5.1m shaft width and lower bypass are representative clearances inside the island between the running tracks.

Northwest rail-support thickness, maintenance-walk width and tunnel-lining shape are representative; mapped tunnel/bridge boundaries determine the supported longitudinal extents, not a surveyed cross-section.
